title: Pocket Planet
desc: Pack for an island picnic. Save for a dream. Make every coin count.
mission: You have 24 pretend coins. Buy your three picnic needs, then protect at least 6 coins for your telescope fund.
take: A plan helps you cover needs, leave room for fun, and save for something you care about.

title: Scam Sleuth
desc: Investigate sneaky messages and protect your digital clubhouse.
mission: Read six clubhouse messages. Choose whether to open, check another way, or block and tell a trusted adult.
take: Slow down when a message asks for secrets, money, or a rushed decision. Check through a route you already trust.

title: Kindness Quest
desc: Help the treehouse crew listen, work together, and set kind boundaries.
mission: The treehouse crew needs your help. Try five small choices that make room for everyone, including you.
take: You can care about someone and still say no. Ask, listen, and make a plan together.

title: Fact Finder
desc: Run a tiny news desk. Sort evidence, opinions, ads, and unchecked claims.
mission: Before a story reaches your news desk, sort each card into evidence, opinion, advertisement, or needs checking.
take: A popular claim is not automatically a fact. Look for a source, context, and something you can check.

title: Repair Café
desc: Give a toy, a book, and a little planter a second chance.
mission: Choose the steps in a sensible order. Inspect first, fix the small problem, then test your repair.
take: Looking closely can save time, materials, and money. Small repairs can give things a second life.

title: Time Trail
desc: Find a clever route through the park and collect every mission flag.
mission: Move to nearby path tiles. Visit all three flags and reach the picnic before your 18-step plan runs out.
take: Plan the whole route before the first step. If a route does not work, reset and try a different one.

title: Garden Guardians
desc: Grow a colorful garden with a small water budget and room for pollinators.
mission: Plant all six plots. Mix carrots, beans, and flowers, then water your garden for three days.
take: Different plants support different needs. Sharing limited water takes planning.

title: Energy Island
desc: Keep your toy island glowing through changing weather and nightfall.
mission: Build a tiny power mix with 12 builder tokens. Supply 6 units on each of four days, including one night.
take: Sources change with conditions. Storing a surplus can help when production drops.

title: Reuse Rally
desc: Clean up Toy Town. Reuse what you can and sort the rest.
mission: Sort ten objects using Toy Town rules: reuse, recycling, compost, or trash. Real local rules can differ.
take: Using something again can avoid waste. Check your local recycling and compost rules with an adult.

title: Robot Rover
desc: Code a little rover, dodge rocks, and discover three star-filled worlds.
mission: Build a command list with forward, turn left, and turn right. Run it, watch what happens, and change your plan.
take: Debugging means noticing what happened and improving one part of your plan. Mistakes are clues.

title: Lemonade Lab
desc: Run a tiny stand. Try a price, watch the weather, and learn from your ledger.
mission: Run your stand for four days. Choose how many cups to make and a price. Supplies cost 1 coin per cup.
take: Revenue is the money that comes in. Profit is what remains after costs. Leftovers and demand matter, too.

title: Beat Builder
desc: Make a beat, try a rhythm challenge, and invent your own sound.
mission: Use the 16-step beat grid. Make a steady kick, an offbeat clap, and a repeating hi-hat. Sound is optional.
take: A repeating pattern creates rhythm. Small changes can make a familiar pattern feel new.

title: KidsCoin Family App
desc: Plan family tasks, practice saving, and choose rewards together.

title: Brain Sweat Expanded
desc: Try coding, shop skills, gardening, and everyday problem-solving challenges.

title: Brain Sweat Life Skills
desc: Explore practical lessons about food, your home, nature, and feelings.

title: Bubble Resonance Φ369
desc: Aim colorful bubbles, bounce clever shots, and make satisfying matches.

title: Chill Brain Rewards
desc: Meet your guide and take a gentle pause with breathing and focus games.

title: Creature Catcher
desc: Catch curious creatures, answer questions, and fill your field guide.

title: Road Trip Quest
desc: Collect power-ups, meet heroes, and solve challenges across eight cities.

title: Road Trip Quest GPS
desc: Explore a pretend neighborhood, discover places, and collect discoveries.
